In this syntax, we'll import all of the DJJ files provided and create two analytic files based on the templates in the second and third tabs here: https://csgorg.sharepoint.com/:x:/s/Team-JC-Research-JJ_AV/EZ-RDTetlZVCoiQxlasiboEBhsT7WNlx5v0qR7sDBji1-A?e=eggzRJ

See `Codebooks` and `Data Diagram` tabs for more information on each individual data file. 




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
### pull in virginia djj data from raw data folder

### set sharepoint path using csgjcr function
sharepoint_ojjdp_va_raw_data <- csgjcr::csg_sp_path(file.path("JJ_OJJDP/Data/VA/raw"))

### set sharepoint path using csgjcr function
sharepoint_ojjdp_va_viz <- csgjcr::csg_sp_path(file.path("JJ_OJJDP/Output/VA/r_viz_output"))

########################################################
### import first excel file w/ multiple tabs with purrr
########################################################

### using purrr::map, import list of tabs from excel worksheet
ojjdp_va_raw_tab_list_file_one <- purrr::map(purrr::set_names(excel_sheets(file.path(sharepoint_ojjdp_va_raw_data,
                                                              "CSG Front End data 01202023 - pt1 - SENSITIVE.xlsx"))),
                      read_excel, 
                      path = file.path(sharepoint_ojjdp_va_raw_data,"CSG Front End data 01202023 - pt1 - SENSITIVE.xlsx")) %>% 
  purrr::map(janitor::clean_names)

### clean names of all imported tabs before converting to dataframes
names(ojjdp_va_raw_tab_list_file_one) <- janitor::make_clean_names(names(ojjdp_va_raw_tab_list_file_one))

### then convert list of tabs to distinct dataframes with names from tabs
purrr::map(names(ojjdp_va_raw_tab_list_file_one),
           ~assign(.x, 
                   ojjdp_va_raw_tab_list_file_one[[.x]], 
        envir = .GlobalEnv)) 
```

```{.r .cell-code}
#############################################
### clean and de-dup df_djj_intake_complaints_raw dataframe by complaint and offense
### this is our base complaint/offense-level file for the sample
#############################################
df_djj_intake_complaints_clean <- df_djj_intake_complaints_raw %>% 
  distinct(juvenile_number,
           case_number,
           offense_number,
           .keep_all=TRUE) %>% ### no records dropped
  ### keep most serious offense associated with intake case/complaint
  dplyr::filter(mso_flag == "Y") %>% 
  ### according to DJJ documentation, multiple offenses may have mso flag of 1 if
  ### severity ranking is tied; so now de-dup those instances 
  ### note: if we decide to further explore counts of offenses/types of status offenses
  ### we will want the full dataframe duplicated by complaint/intake/offense
  distinct(juvenile_number,
           case_number,
           .keep_all=TRUE) %>% 
  ### clean race/ethnicity and gender
  ### use factor function to assign labels to values
  mutate(race_clean = case_when(
    race=="I" & hispanic!="Y" ~ 1,
    race=="A" & hispanic!="Y" ~ 2,
    race=="B" & hispanic!="Y" ~ 3,
    hispanic=="Y" ~ 4,
    race=="W" & hispanic!="Y" ~ 5,
    race %in% c("X","O") & hispanic!="Y" ~ 6,
    TRUE ~ 7),
    race_clean = factor(race_clean,
         levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7),
         labels = c("American Indian", "Asian", "Black", "Hispanic", "White", "Other","Missing"))) %>% 
  mutate(gender_clean = case_when(
    sex=="F" ~ 1,
    sex=="M" ~ 2,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)),
    gender_clean = factor(gender_clean,
         levels = c(1,2),
         labels = c("Female", "Male"))) %>% 
  ### temp cleaning of age -- pending feedback from DJJ
  mutate(petition_age_clean = case_when(
    pet_age < 12 ~ 1,
    pet_age>= 12 &  pet_age< 14 ~ 2,
    pet_age>= 14 &  pet_age< 16 ~ 3,
    pet_age>= 16 &  pet_age< 18 ~ 4,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)),
    petition_age_clean = factor(petition_age_clean,
         levels = c(1,2,3,4),
         labels = c("Less than 12", 
                    "12 to 13",
                    "14 to 15",
                    "16 to 18")),
    intake_age_clean = case_when(
    intake_age < 12 ~ 1,
    intake_age>= 12 &  intake_age< 14 ~ 2,
    intake_age>= 14 &  intake_age< 16 ~ 3,
    intake_age>= 16 &  intake_age< 18 ~ 4,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)),
    intake_age_clean = factor(intake_age_clean,
         levels = c(1,2,3,4),
         labels = c("Less than 12", 
                    "12 to 13",
                    "14 to 15",
                    "16 to 18"))) %>%   
  ### clean dates and create year for potential grouping in future trend analysis
  mutate(date_opened = ymd(as_date(excel_numeric_to_date(as.numeric(as.character(date_opened)), 
                                                  date_system = "modern"))),
         ysai_date = ymd(as_date(ysai_date)),
         date_opened_year = year(date_opened)) 
```

```{.r .cell-code}
### unique youth and complaints per year
df_complaints_youth_intake_decision <- df_djj_intake_complaints_clean %>% 
  mutate(intake_decision = as.numeric(intake_decision)) %>% 
  left_join(codebook_intake_decision_values,
            by = "intake_decision") %>% 
  ### create flags for (NOTE:THIS IS PRELIMINARY AND PENDING CONFIRMATION WITH DJJ RESEARCH STAFF)
  # intake decisions (petitioned, diverted, dismissed, other)
  # diversion (yes or no)
  # diversion outcome (successful, not successful and petitioned, not successful and not petitioned); what to do with "REQ'D TO PARTICIPATE-DIVERSION"?
  # disposition outcomes (where intake complaint is petitioned)
  ### create unique complaint-level ID
  mutate(intake_decision_clean = case_when(
    intake_decision_label%in%c("UNSUCCESSFUL DIVERSION/PETITION FILED", "SUCCESSFUL DIVERSION","UNSUCCESSFUL DIVERSION/NO PETITION FILED","REQ'D TO PARTICIPATE-DIVERSION") ~ "Diverted",
    intake_decision_label%in%c("PETITION FILED", "PETITION/DETENTION ORDER FILED","COURT SUMMONS","PETITION/SHELTER CARE FILED") ~ "Petitioned",    
    intake_decision_label%in%c("RESOLVED", "COMPLAINT UNFOUNDED","UNOFFICIAL COUNSELING-FAMILY C") ~ "Dismissed",
    intake_decision_label%in%c("DETENTION ORDER ONLY", "REFERRED TO ANOTHER AGY FOR SV","ACCEPTED VIA ICJ","RETURNED TO PROBATION SUPERVIS","PENDING","SHELTER CARE ONLY","RETURNED TO OUT-OF-STATE") ~ "Other",
   TRUE ~ as.character(NA)),
    intake_decision_clean = factor(intake_decision_clean,
                              levels = c("Petitioned","Diverted","Dismissed","Other")),                            
         intake_diverted_flag = ifelse(intake_decision_label%in%c("UNSUCCESSFUL DIVERSION/PETITION FILED", "SUCCESSFUL DIVERSION","UNSUCCESSFUL DIVERSION/NO PETITION FILED","REQ'D TO PARTICIPATE-DIVERSION"),
                                1,0),
         intake_diverted_flag = factor(intake_diverted_flag,
                                levels = c(1,0),
                                labels = c("Yes","No")),
         diversion_successful_flag = ifelse(intake_decision_label%in%c("SUCCESSFUL DIVERSION"),
                                1,0),
         diversion_not_successful_flag = ifelse(intake_decision_label%in%c("UNSUCCESSFUL DIVERSION/PETITION FILED","UNSUCCESSFUL DIVERSION/NO PETITION FILED"),
                                1,0),
         unique_complaint_id = paste0(juvenile_number,case_number)) %>% 
  ### create var for jj history using flags provided by DJJ
   mutate(jj_history_clean = case_when(
    prior_adj==0 ~ "No Prior JJ History",
    prior_other>0 ~ "Prior 'Other' History",
    (prior_chinsup>0 | prior_chins>0 | prior_other_status>0) ~ "Prior Status/CHINS/CHINsup",
    prior_misd>0 ~ "Prior Misdemeanor",
    prior_felony>0 ~ "Prior Felony",
    TRUE ~ as.character(NA)),
    jj_history_clean = factor(jj_history_clean,
                              levels = c("No Prior JJ History","Prior 'Other' History","Prior Status/CHINS/CHINsup","Prior Misdemeanor","Prior Felony")))
```

```{.r .cell-code}
########################################
### clean and de-dup disposition dataframe
########################################
### note: disposition file is unique by youth, case number, offense number, disposition, amd days from intake to disposition
disposition_clean <- disposition %>% 
  ### remove records with missing disposition -- waiting on answer from DJJ on how to interpret this
  filter(!is.na(description)==TRUE) %>% 
  distinct(juvenile_number,
           case_number,
           offense_number,
           description,
           .keep_all=TRUE) %>% ### no records dropped
  ### preliminary options for grouping dispositions are: Detention, Commitment, Probation/Supervision, Deferral, Community Service, Fine, Treatment/Programming, No further action/none, Restitution, Other
  mutate(dispo_description_clean = case_when(
    description%in%c("COMMIT TO DJJ (16.1-278.8.14)","SERIOUS OFFENDER COMMITMENT TO DJJ (16.1-278.8.17) (16.1-285.1)","SUSPENDED COMMITMENT TO DJJ") ~ "Commitment",
    description%in%c("POST-DISPOSITIONAL DETENTION (16.1-278.8.16) (16.1-284.1)","SENTENCED TO DETENTION","SUSPENDED COMMITMENT TO DETENTION") ~ "Detention",
    description%in%c("COURT ORDER CONDITIONS AND LIMITATIONS (16.1-278.8.2)", "DEFER FINDING AND DISPOSITION W/PROBATION SUPERVISION (16.1-278.8.5)","PROBATION (16.1-278.8.7)","PROBATION AND COURT ORDERED ALCOHOL OR DRUG ABUSE TREATMENT (16.1-278.8.7a") ~ "Probation/Supervision",
    description%in%c("DEFER DISPOSITION ON CONDITION OF GOOD BEHAVIOR") ~ "Deferral",
    description%in%c("(EXPIRED) DEFER DISPOSTION AND PLACE IN BOOT CAMP (16.1-278.8.4a)", "COURT ORDER GANG ACTIVITY PREVENTION PROGRAM (16.1-278.8.19)","COURT ORDER NON-RESIDENTIAL PARENT PARTICIPATION IN PROGRAMS (16.1-278.8.6)","COURT ORDER PARENT PARTICIPATION IN PROGRAMS...FOR REHABILITATION (16.1-278.8.3)","FIRST OFFENSE DRUG VIOLATION, MANDATORY TREATMENT (16.1-278.8:01)") ~ "Treatment/Programming",
    description%in%c("NO FURTHER ACTION") ~ "No further action/none",
    description%in%c("COMMUNITY SERVICE (16.1-278.8.11)") ~ "Community Service",
    description%in%c("FINE NOT TO EXCEED $500 (16.1-278.8.8)") ~ "Fine",
    description%in%c("RESTITUTION (16.1-278.8.10)") ~ "Restitution",
    description%in%c("LOSS OF DRIVING PRIVS FOR ALCOHOL,FIREARM,OR TRUANCY(16.1-278.8.18)(16.1-278.9)","SENTENCED IN CIRCUIT COURT","SUSPEND DRIVER'S LICENSE/IMPOSE CURFEW (16.1-278.8.9)","TRAFFIC VIOLATION PENALTIES (16.1-278.8.12)","TRANSFER LEGAL CUSTODY (16.1-278.8.12)","UPHOLDING RULING OF THE LOWER COURT","(EXPIRED) TRANSFER TO CIRCUIT COURT","ADULT SENTENCED FOR JUVENILE OFFENSE (16.1-278.8.15) (16.1-284)") ~ "Other",
```
